about: TSH's music cues. Edit with: python3 tools/score/serve.py

intro.city.when: The opening: the city at night, the gang, the drones (as the VO starts)

wake.call.when: Black; the phone rings, the buyer's call

wake.suit.when: After the call: she gets ready, the kit piece by piece

wake.door.when: She stops at the door, facing the kitchen

wake.dinner.when: The kitchen: dinner still covered, her mother's note

wake.window.when: The window goes up, the city comes in — the sill, the look down, the jump (loop holds the beat before the drop)

wake.fall.when: Off the sill, falling slowly until SPACE (keeps the held beat, opens the filter)

wake.drop.when: SPACE: the shoes fire — the drop, then the first roofs

deal.fight.when: The fight with the buyer's crew starts

raid.chase.when: The drone chase is yours (each stage start / retry)

raid.home.when: She makes it back to her own roof

night.watchers.when: The watchers on the roof across — the tentacles rise

morning.shoes.when: Getting ready: the shoes go on (fires 0.7 s after the launch sound)

station.canon.when: Canon steps up to her — the monster song's low opening, waiting under both fights

station.canon.song.when: Canon steps up (the song player, at the same time)

station.grab.when: The grab — the gizmo falls and beeps (held breath)

station.glitch.when: Maya glitches — 'at' lands as she comes up out of it

station.hers.when: Canon is swallowed — 'at' lands as the fight is hers

station.brawl.when: She fights it on her own feet (loops while she fights)

station.run.when: RUN — 'at' lands as she runs, to the end

station.retry.when: Too much for her — the night starts over

station.out.when: Out of the tunnels, onto the street

station.hide.when: She has lost them; somewhere dark she stops and calls him
